Market today: Tech is stumbling, facing a crucial week. Rising borrowing costs are a big headwind, potentially outweighing strong earnings. This directly hits your growth-heavy, margin-fueled book.

Your holdings: Several leveraged ETFs (MUU, SOXL, SPAL) are deep in the red and have breached their stops or are very close. SMH and SMCI are also significant losers with "SELL" status and breached stops. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on borrowing costs and how tech reacts to earnings this week. Also, monitor global debt crisis fears from Europe.

Bottom line: Your leveraged, concentrated book is under pressure; managing risk and respecting stops is paramount right now.
plays: Address breached stops: SMH (price 539.79, stop 540), MUU (price 24.34, stop 31.6), SMCI (price 31.63, stop 37.3), SPAL (price 15.73, stop 21.38) are all trading below their listed stops. Review these positions immediately to manage risk.
